tool_args.rationale: The verified sink-coupled dual-horizon mechanism and the short pilot window make long-horizon measurements necessary to identify the slow adaptation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit sink-coupled dual-horizon model using pilot rows only
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow adaptation needed for the H=23.3 forecast.
A fine short trajectory is less directly informative about long-horizon reversal.
It does not resolve the horizon ambiguity.
